(30 August) | average attendance = 4,529 | prevseason = [[2025 K League 2|2025]] | nextseason = [[2027 K League 2|2027]] | updated = 11 October 2026 }} The '''2026 K League 2''', also known as the '''Hana Bank K League 2''' for sponsorship reasons, is the 14th season of the [[K League 2]], the second-highest division in [[South Korean football league system]]. ==Overview== The league has expand to 17 teams for this season. Two teams relegated from K League 1, and the twelve teams remaining in the league, two teams promoted from the K3 League and one newly established club. K League 2 will be reduced or expanded to 15 or 16 teams starting next season, due to the expansion of [[K League 1]] from 12 to 14 teams, no team will be automatically relegated from the top tier. This season, Promotion and Relegation between K League 2 and [[K3 League]] have been introduce for 2026 onwards. First and second place are promoted automatically, while third and sixth place face a promotion play-off, the winner of the promotion play-off final will automatically be promoted, the loser of the promotion play-off final will face-off against the 12th place team of K League 1 (only if [[Gimcheon Sangmu FC|Gimcheon Sangmu]] does not finish last). Last place in K League 2 will face -off against the Champions of K3 League in the inaugural Relegation play-off round. ==Teams== === Team Changes === As the 2025 K League 2 champions, [[Incheon United FC|Incheon United]] and the play-off winners [[Bucheon FC 1995]] have been promoted to the [[K League 1]].{{cite web |title=Bucheon FC 1995 Secures Historic Promotion to K League 1 |url=https://www.chosun.com/english/sports-en/2025/12/08/KPR5RTDJRRGPJN6U72ET7IPEZU/}}{{cite web |title=Incheon United Sweeps K League 2 Title, Awards, Promotion |url=https://www.chosun.com/english/sports-en/2025/12/02/C6NKF62AN5FVZEBFSCUNMYCDBE/}} Both teams ended in the second tier after one and twelve years, respectively. Meanwhile, [[Suwon FC]] and [[Daegu FC]] have been relegated from the [[K League 1]].{{cite web |title=Daegu FC has been demoted |url=https://www.mk.co.kr/en/sports/11480838}}{{cite web |title=Suwon FC Relegated After Benching Top Scorer Ssabak |website=The Chosun Daily |date=9 December 2025 |url=https://www.chosun.com/english/sports-en/2025/12/09/5NUP6MD4DRHINITIIVXRWDDBO4/ |access-date=15 December 2025}} Daegu FC and Suwon FC return to second tier after nine and five years absence, respectively. Additionally, [[Gimhae FC 2008]] and [[Paju Frontier FC|Paju Frontier]] have been accepted into the [[K League 2]] following a decision by the K League Federation, having participated in the [[K3 League]] since 2020 and 2021.{{cite news |url=https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20250811123100007 |script-title=ko:김해·용인·파주 회원가입 승인…내년 K리그2 17개 팀으로 |lang=ko |publisher=Yonhap News Agency |date=11 August 2025|access-date=23 December 2025}} In August 2025, [[Yongin FC]] received approval to join the [[K League]], confirming its intention to participate in the [[2026 K League 2]].{{Cite web |last=Ham |first=Seung-tae |date=18 August 2025 |title=용인FC, K리그2 가입 승인받아 창단 현실화 |trans-title=Yongin FC confirms its foundation with approval to join K League 2 |url=https://www.yongin21.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=82789 |access-date=31 December 2025 |website=Yonin Simin Shinmun |language=ko}} On 16 January 2026, two teams from K3 League and one newly established team will participate in K League 2 for the 2026 season after its final approval for membership in the K League Federation. {| class="wikitable" |+ '''Incoming Teams''' |- !
